purpose: Qualify complete-system repeatability of the minimally seeded original M-TARE baseline before any paired method comparison.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-5 infrastructure qualification: tunnel only; original M-TARE only; seed 11 twice and seed 23 once; 60 simulation seconds per trial; no model inference, training, topology method comparison, C09 or C10.
approval.confirmation_reference: After the exact three-trial, 180-simulation-second scope and pass/fail evidence were stated, the user replied '批准'; their preceding message also stated '全部都批准'.

raw_sources: Runnable metadata clone sha256:5cbede29e4229e92d85ebaf919be2fb9ebc4ad9ed97029b7639997779062748c; only the invalid inherited /etc/localtime VOLUME declaration is removed.
AEE tunnel simulator world; no generated C08/C09/C10 research sample is read.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local reproducibility qualification of the existing research baseline.

validation: AEE tunnel development simulator world, system qualification only
strict_test: C10 and every formal benchmark/test world are forbidden

sampling.rule: Retain every recorded ROS message, but bind the exact qualification comparison to the first 100 scan-synchronous scan/pose pairs and first 20 planner waypoints from each trial: 300 frames and 60 waypoints total. The two seed-11 trials are repeat measurements, not independent samples.

teacher.source: No teacher, label, learned model or oracle is read.
teacher.valid_mask: Every required common recording topic must exist, match its frozen ROS type and contain at least one message.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: The two seed-11 trials must have identical relative timestamps, scan hashes, pose hashes and waypoint values. The seed-23 observed scan/trajectory sequence must differ.

split.historical_pollution_audit: This is a baseline-system reproducibility diagnostic, not training, selection, calibration or a performance estimate. No benchmark result is consumed.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU plus Gazebo simulation, three serial 60-second trials; zero GPU, model inference, training or optimization.

evidence.machine_metrics: Three complete rosbag files, 300 frame fingerprints, 60 waypoint values, per-topic inventories, same/different-seed comparison, image/tool hashes, logs, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
evidence.complete_visual_review: No visual judgment is needed for exact reproducibility; raw scans and poses remain in the bags for inspection.
evidence.failure_policy: Any drift, startup error, missing/type-invalid topic, insufficient frame/waypoint count, same-seed difference or absent different-seed variation is immediate sealed FAIL. No retry or tolerance change.
